DESCRIPTION: Canonical Resource Ontology and Industrial Dependency Knowledge Base for Sovereign Intelligence

CRUDE_OIL.name: Crude Petroleum & Hydrocarbons
CRUDE_OIL.upstreamProcess: Deep Drilling, Subsea Extraction, Thermal EOR
CRUDE_OIL.midstreamProcess: Atmospheric & Vacuum Distillation, Fluid Catalytic Cracking, Hydrotreating
keyUtilities: Primary fuel for freight rail, maritime shipping, and road transport logistics
Essential feedstock for petrochemicals, synthetic polymers, and pharmaceuticals
Aviation and military mechanized force operational mobility
Backup thermal electricity generation

lackConsequences.shortTerm: Immediate spike in freight logistics costs, diesel rationing, public transport slowdown
lackConsequences.mediumTerm: Supply chain gridlock, fertilizer delivery failure, industrial factory power curtailment
lackConsequences.catastrophic: Total transport paralysis, food distribution collapse, mechanized military immobilization, blackouts

enrichmentDynamics.strategicLeverage: Ability to dictate terms to import-dependent nations, weaponize export quotas, petro-currency leverage
enrichmentDynamics.sovereignWealth: Massive export fiscal surplus, sovereign wealth fund capital accumulation
enrichmentDynamics.hazards: Dutch Disease (currency overvaluation crushing domestic manufacturing), commodity price volatility trap

NATURAL_GAS.name: Natural Gas & Methane
NATURAL_GAS.upstreamProcess: Hydraulic Fracturing, Conventional Gas Wells, Associated Gas Capture
NATURAL_GAS.midstreamProcess: Cryogenic Liquefaction (LNG), Regasification Terminals, Pipeline Compression
keyUtilities: Baseload and peaking electrical grid power generation (CCGT turbines)
Primary chemical feedstock for Haber-Bosch ammonia synthesis (global food security)
Industrial high-temperature heat for glass, ceramics, and metal smelting
Urban residential and commercial heating networks

lackConsequences.shortTerm: Surging electricity spot prices, fertilizer plant shutdowns, industrial curtailments
lackConsequences.mediumTerm: Widespread food crop yield drops due to nitrogen fertilizer deficit, winter heating emergency
lackConsequences.catastrophic: Grid collapse, agricultural famine cascade, deep macroeconomic stagflation

enrichmentDynamics.strategicLeverage: Control over regional power grids and global food security via fertilizer ammonia inputs
enrichmentDynamics.sovereignWealth: High-margin LNG contracts, infrastructure transit fee collection
enrichmentDynamics.hazards: Extreme pipeline lock-in vulnerability, transit chokepoint exposure

COPPER.name: Refined Copper & Concentrates
COPPER.upstreamProcess: Open-Pit Mining, Heap Bio-Leaching, Froth Flotation
COPPER.midstreamProcess: Flash Smelting, Electro-Refining to Grade-A Cathode 99.99%
keyUtilities: High-conductivity wiring for electrical grids, power transformers, and substations
Electric vehicle (EV) motor windings, inverters, and battery interconnects
Semiconductor lead frames, telecommunication cable, and heat exchangers
Industrial plumbing, anti-microbial surfaces, and defense electronics

lackConsequences.shortTerm: Electrical grid expansion halted, transformer manufacturing backlogs, electronics cost surge
lackConsequences.mediumTerm: Green energy transition stalled, EV factory assembly lines suspended, power grid reliability drops
lackConsequences.catastrophic: Infrastructure gridlock, inability to rebuild bombed or weathered power infrastructure

enrichmentDynamics.strategicLeverage: Kingmaker in global electrification, green tech supply chains, and power grid equipment
enrichmentDynamics.sovereignWealth: Mining royalty windfalls, downstream wire-drawing and smelting industrialization
enrichmentDynamics.hazards: Severe water stress around porphyry deposits, sulfuric acid leaching environmental liability

LITHIUM.name: Lithium Carbonate & Hydroxide
LITHIUM.upstreamProcess: Salar Brine Evaporation Ponds, Spodumene Hard-Rock Mining & Acid Roasting
LITHIUM.midstreamProcess: Chemical Conversion to Battery-Grade Li2CO3 / LiOH (>99.5% purity)
keyUtilities: Lithium-ion battery storage for electric mobility and grid-scale ESS
Aerospace light alloys (Lithium-Aluminum)
Specialty high-temperature industrial greases and glass-ceramics
Electrochemical capacitors and defense communications

lackConsequences.shortTerm: Battery cell assembly shutdowns, automotive OEM production cuts
lackConsequences.mediumTerm: Loss of domestic EV market share, delayed grid decarbonization, defense drone battery shortage
lackConsequences.catastrophic: Technological obsolescence and complete reliance on foreign battery ecosystems

enrichmentDynamics.strategicLeverage: Monopoly pricing power over 21st-century transport electrification and storage
enrichmentDynamics.sovereignWealth: High-margin chemical processing margins and joint-venture FDI attraction
enrichmentDynamics.hazards: Extreme price boom-and-bust cycles, water depletion in arid salt-flat ecosystems

RARE_EARTHS.midstreamProcess: Multi-Stage Liquid-Liquid Solvent Extraction (Hundreds of Separation Stages), Metal Reduction
keyUtilities: Permanent neodymium-iron-boron (NdFeB) magnets for wind turbine direct-drive generators
Precision-guided missile actuators, radar phased arrays, and stealth aircraft skins
EV drivetrain traction motors and acoustic transducers
Fiber optic amplifiers, MRI imaging scanners, and oil refining catalysts

lackConsequences.shortTerm: Defense procurement paralysis, missile assembly bottlenecks, wind turbine delivery halts
lackConsequences.mediumTerm: Inability to manufacture high-efficiency motors, defense industrial sovereign vulnerability
lackConsequences.catastrophic: Strategic military unreadiness, collapse of advanced radar and guidance systems

enrichmentDynamics.strategicLeverage: Total geopolitical chokehold over Western defense manufacturing and clean-tech supply
enrichmentDynamics.sovereignWealth: Downstream captive tech manufacturing hub creation
enrichmentDynamics.hazards: Thorium/uranium radioactive tailings management, highly toxic acid runoff

Food-grade additives, beverages, and detergents

lackConsequences.shortTerm: Agronomic panic, fertilizer hoardings, farmer protests, input cost inflation
lackConsequences.mediumTerm: 20-40% collapse in harvest crop yields, staple food supply deficits, food price inflation
lackConsequences.catastrophic: Massive famine, rural food riots, societal destabilization, civil unrest

enrichmentDynamics.strategicLeverage: Ultimate caloric weapon — ability to influence global food security and UN voting blocs
enrichmentDynamics.sovereignWealth: Perennial non-elastic global agricultural cash flows
enrichmentDynamics.hazards: Phosphogypsum waste stacks containing low-level radioactive radium, brine sinkhole risks

enrichmentDynamics.hazards: Non-proliferation treaty oversight, international sanctions risk, radiation safety mandates
